verdict.rationale: Factory's Droid CLI and App let users delegate tasks, request changes, and run slash commands (e.g., /readiness-report, /missions, /droids) entirely via natural-language or conversational prompts, with the system interpreting mockups, diffs, and instructions rather than requiring code. Extensive first-party docs across CLI, App, and Missions confirm this is core to the product's design as an 'agent-native' platform. missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports corroborating the natural-language UX beyond vendor docs.
